mapper.update: update sys_hr_renewal_guard g set status = 'ACTIVE', action_id = #{actionId}, task_id = #{replacementTaskId}, version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where g.employee_id = #{employeeId} and g.scenario = #{scenario} and g.status = 'IDLE' and g.action_id is null and g.task_id is null and g.version = #{expectedVersion} and exists ( select 1 from sys_hr_lifecycle_action action_row where action_row.action_id = #{actionId} and action_row.employee_id = #{employeeId} and action_row.action_type in ('RENEWAL_CONFIRMED', 'RENEWAL_DECLINED') ) and not exists ( select 1 from oa_sign_task other_open where other_open.employee_id = #{employeeId} and other_open.scenario = 'RENEWAL' and other_open.task_id != #{replacementTaskId} and other_open.status not in ('SIGNED', 'REFUSED', 'EXPIRED', 'CANCELLED', 'NO_ACTION') ) and exists ( select 1 from oa_sign_task source_task inner join oa_sign_task replacement_task on replacement_task.task_id = #{replacementTaskId} and replacement_task.reissue_of_task_id = source_task.task_id and replacement_task.employee_id = source_task.employee_id and replacement_task.scenario = source_task.scenario and replacement_task.status = 'NEW' where source_task.task_id = #{sourceTerminalTaskId} and source_task.employee_id = #{employeeId} and source_task.scenario = 'RENEWAL' and source_task.status in ('REFUSED', 'EXPIRED') and source_task.resolution_status = 'REISSUED' and source_task.reissued_to_task_id = replacement_task.task_id and source_task.source_business_id = cast(#{actionId} as char) )

update sys_hr_renewal_guard g set status = 'RESERVED', action_id = #{actionId}, version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where g.employee_id = #{employeeId} and g.scenario = #{scenario} and g.status = 'IDLE' and g.action_id is null and g.task_id is null and g.version = #{expectedVersion} and exists ( select 1 from sys_hr_lifecycle_action a inner join sys_hr_sign_event_outbox o on o.action_id = a.action_id and o.event_version = a.version where a.action_id = #{actionId} and a.employee_id = #{employeeId} and a.action_type in ('RENEWAL_CONFIRMED', 'RENEWAL_DECLINED') and o.status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY', 'SENDING', 'DEAD') and not exists ( select 1 from sys_hr_lifecycle_action older inner join sys_hr_sign_event_outbox older_o on older_o.action_id = older.action_id and older_o.event_version = older.version where older.employee_id = a.employee_id and older.action_type in ('RENEWAL_CONFIRMED', 'RENEWAL_DECLINED') and older.action_id < a.action_id and older_o.status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY', 'SENDING', 'DEAD') ) )
